segments_b.text: I have watched long. I see what you carry. Courage and conquest both.
Lay down conquest, keep courage. Then enter. I am the south door. Heat that does not burn the willing.
Sky that still belongs to the ground. Capable of ending a fight.
Choosing not to. Friends may pass.
